    n = std::str::length(s)
    fn at(i):
        std::str::substring(s, i, i + 1):
            on UpperOverrun:
                ""
            on LowerUnderrun:
                ""
    fn scan(start):
        loop i from start to n:
            if at(i) == " ":
                return i
        n
    fn tail(i):
        e = scan(i)
        e - i
    [scan(0), tail(1), tail(n)]
